name: calendula officinalis flowering top + sepia officinalis juice
uses: Uses Temporarily relieves vaginal dryness. emporarily relieves discomfort due to vaginal dryness. Temporarily relieves discomfort during intimacy due to vaginal dryness. For the temporary relief of minor vaginal discomfort and feelings of irritation.
otcwarn: Warnings For vaginal use only. Do not use: if you are allergic to any of the ingredients if the foil pouch is damaged or previously opened Ask a doctor before use if you have a vaginal infection or are being treated for one abnormal vaginal bleeding or discharge any other vaginal or pelvic condition diagnosed by a healthcare professional When using this product : use only as directed; do not use more than once every 48 hours unless directed by a healthcare professional; mild burning, itching, or irritation may occur — if these worsen or persist, discontinue use; avoid contact with eyes — if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water; do not reuse or share applicators; do not use with other intravaginal products (douches, spermicides, antifungal treatments) unless directed by a healthcare professional. Stop use and ask a doctor if: symptoms do not improve after 3 applications or worsen during use; you experience severe vaginal irritation, abnormal discharge, or unexpected bleeding; you develop fever, chills, or abdominal pain. If pregnant or breastfeeding , ask a healthcare professional before use. Keep out of reach of children . If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away
